'''2009 Coruscant Regionals James Booker DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[James Booker]] at [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Booker
* '''Deck name:''' Mr. Klown Is ELITE
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
